subject: AtlasOps renewal kickoff — capacity stretch, term changes & QBR planning

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: AtlasOps renewal kickoff — capacity stretch, term changes & QBR planning

Alex — thanks again for the time last week. Wanted to get the kickoff thread started so we can lock timelines and stakeholders for the renewal + proposed capacity uplift. High level: 

- Objective: sign a 12–18 month renewal with a stepped capacity uplift (20% initial bump, optional burst pool) and an opportunity to move to a longer-term committed discount at year 2.
- Immediate asks (this week): confirm internal stakeholders, preferred QBR window, and whether Procurement should start a terms review now.
- Proposed timeline: mutual action plan attached (redwood_commit_outline.xlsx) — target commercial agreement by Nov 30, operational handoff and QBR in early Dec.

Two concrete slots we can offer for a 30–45m QBR/handshake next week: Tue 11/17 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 11/18 14:00–14:45 PT. If neither works please suggest 2 alternatives.

Attachments: AtlasOps_QBR_Agenda_v1.pdf (draft agenda), redwood_commit_outline.xlsx (deal outline).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an internal ops checklist and a DocuSign route if we get verbal buy-in.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien

Connor — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:

- Stakeholders: myself (Platform), Dana Park (Engineering lead, dana.park@atlasops.com), and Procurement (copied). For exec readout we’ll include our Head of AI, Jenna Silva.
- QBR slot: Wed 11/18 14:00 PT works best for the group (confirming with Dana).
- Timeline: Procurement has a 2–3 week review cadence for contract changes; if we can surface a redline preview today that will speed review. Can you include the proposed term language for the stepped capacity & burst pool?

Also, two asks from Engineering: 1) can Redwood commit to a documented latency SLO for the steady-state uplift, and 2) is there a short ops-runbook we can include for failover to lower-capacity model variants?

I’ll loop internal stakeholders once we have the Docusign/term preview.

Thanks,

QBR logistics: Wed 11/18 14:00 PT confirmed. Agenda will be: 1) Exec goals & timelines (10m), 2) Capacity plan & SLOs (10m), 3) Ops/readout & runbook (10m), 4) Commercial terms & next steps (15m).
